title: kithctl watch: notifications show (unknown) sender — wrong JMAP field name
description: fetch_and_notify requests properties:["sender","body"] and reads msg.get("sender"). The JMAP wire field is "senderId", not "sender". Result: sender is always None, every notification shows "(unknown)" as sender. Two-line fix: change "sender" to "senderId" in the properties array and in the .get() call.
